ffn_boundary_31344.finding: The earliest observed discrete divergence is the Q8_K activation input after the initial RMSNorm: row 5, column 868 scales to -28.500001907348633 in Rust versus -28.499996185302734 in the independent reference, giving codes -29 and -28. The 2.46249e-8 RMSNorm rRMSE is small, but input QDQ is discontinuous. First-layer downstream code differences increase to 442 at FFN norm and 7788 at the down-projection input. Isolated tested operations pass diagnostic F32 gates; this is evidence of rounding-threshold propagation, not proof that every later-layer kernel or end-to-end model is correct.
